cooked: The w \le 2^{208} condition is doing real work in the chain-work rounding bound: it lets you lower-bound each block’s work by W_\text{unit}d. It may be worth stating close to the headline result that the explicit formula is proved only up to that work limit, even though the practical 2^{128} security cutoff is much lower.
